text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retire this superseded result/export umbrella. Current ResultArtifacts.scala defines all named shared artifacts, provenance, export intent and voxelwise covariance; ResultManifestWriter implements bundled/individual BIDS-style NIfTI, covariance TSV and sidecars. Fresh focused verification passed 16 JVM and 10 JS tests (ResultArtifactsSuite, ImageMapsSuite, plus JVM ResultManifestWriterSuite), including physical export and explicit HDF5/GDS rejection. No HDF5/GDS implementation is claimed. More decisively, active P1 successor bd-01KX6G9B8R86MRBZ9S8K8F5G7V explicitly requires replacing ResultManifestWriter and its inadequate durable ResultManifest facade, permits breaking unused APIs, and supersedes preservation of compatibility layouts. Expanding this legacy writer with optional formats would now conflict with that adopted direction. Close as superseded, not as universal format coverage or completed estimate-set durability. Keep the P1 successor open and retain useful in-memory extraction/display types only where its plan justifies them. No source changes were made for this assessment.
